---
title: "Volcano plot and Bar plot"
author: "Zhao2026"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
##Bar plot
library("ggplot2")
library("scales")
KEGG<-read.csv("KEGG.csv",header = T)
p<-ggplot(KEGG,aes(x=count,y=Pathway,fill=Pvalue))+geom_bar(stat = "identity",width=0.7)+scale_fill_gradient(low="red",high="blue",limits=c(0,max(KEGG$Pvalue)),labels=scientific_format(diprgits = 2))+scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(KEGG$Pathway)))
print(p)

GO<-read.csv("GO.csv",header = T)
p<-ggplot(GOBP,aes(x=count,y=Pathway,fill=Pvalue))+geom_bar(stat = "identity",width=0.7)+scale_fill_gradient(low="red",high="blue",limits=c(0,max(GO$Pvalue)),labels=scientific_format(diprgits = 2))+scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(GO$Pathway)))
print(p)
```
